title_zh: 阳朔:竹筏上的田园风光
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (14/20): Yangshuo, Countryside from a Bamboo Raft
note_en: 把…当作… means "to treat or see something as something": 许多背包客把阳朔当作…理想之地 "many backpackers see Yangshuo as the ideal place..." The pattern is close to English "see X as Y," but 把 brings X forward before the verb, so the thing being judged comes first and its new role last. The same structure appears in 当地人也把西街称为「洋人街」 "locals call West Street 'Foreigners' Street,'" and in the closing line 把阳朔当作了一个想要回来的地方 "came to see Yangshuo as a place she wanted to return to."
